## Instrument Specification

<!-- image -->

| Specification                                                            | Design value                                                |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Field-of-View (hexagon)                                                  | ~4.8 degree 2 ( ⌀ >2.7 ° )                                  |
| Multiplex fiber positioner                                               | ~2400                                                       |
| Medium Resolution Spectrographs (2x) # Fibres Passband Velocity accuracy | R~5000-7000 1600 fibres 390-930 nm < 2 km/s                 |
| High Resolution Spectrograph (1x) # Fibres Passband Velocity accuracy    | R~20,000 800 fibres 392-437 & 515-572 & 605-675 nm < 1 km/s |
| # of fibers in ⌀ =2' circle                                              | >3                                                          |
| Fibre diameter                                                           | ⌀ =1.4 arcsec                                               |
| Area (first 5 year survey)                                               | >2h x 16,000 deg 2                                          |
| Number of science spectra (5 year)                                       | ~75 million of 20 min                                       |
